captions.text: 9 September 2005. It would not stop raining.
Miles, nineteen, thumbed through videos on the TV while the storm argued with the roof.
Something outside broke.
THE WORLD ENDS IN 2006.
Rumours. Miles rolled his eyes and swiped it away.
Bro. It's real. It's in a book nobody can name. Even World War 3 is in it... and it already happened.
captions.speaker: friend

captions.text: It's a rumour with better marketing.
captions.speaker: miles

captions.text: Months passed. The prediction became a religion. People loved harder, laughed louder, called their mothers.
A few stayed unconvinced. Miles was one of them.
31 December 2005. 11:58 p.m.
A sound so large it should have ended the world.
A person a thousand kilometres away would have heard it. It should have made him deaf forever.
His ears were fine. That was the first thing that felt wrong.
So he went back to bed.
The next evening, Miles saw two moons.
Not a special effect. Not a weapon. Just... two.
He asked. They laughed. One of them crossed the street.
He remembered going to sleep on 31 December 2005.
The television said: 24 July 2024.
Eighteen years. Six thousand seven hundred eighty days. He had not aged a single one.
He understood. And that was when they came.
Miles could not dodge it.
There was nothing to dodge.
Timeline shifts this fast and the brain is still intact. It's rare.
captions.speaker: strangerA

captions.text: Log him. Next MC.
captions.speaker: strangerB

captions.text: The one who survives a shift and still understands everything is called an MC. A Main Character.
